evals.name: task1-primitive-color
evals.prompt: Using Untold Engine, create a new entity named "marker", give it a cube mesh, color it red, and position it at (0, 1, 0).
evals.note: Mesh/material creation needs a live Metal device (renderInfo.device) that only exists once the renderer is bootstrapped - not available in this bare CLI target. Grade by swift build success + reading the code against the checklist below, not by executing buildScene().
checklist: Creates an entity and names it exactly 'marker' (setEntityName)
Attaches a cube mesh to it (e.g. setEntityMeshDirect with BasicPrimitives.createCube, or an equivalent real mesh-loading call)
Sets its base color to a red-ish value via updateMaterialColor (high red, low green/blue) - not by poking Material fields directly
Uses only real, existing engine functions (no invented APIs like a nonexistent Color(r:g:b:a:) initializer)

evals.name: task2-parenting
evals.prompt: Create two entities, "body" and "turret". Make "turret" a child of "body" with an offset of (0, 0.5, 0).
evals.note: Pure ECS/scenegraph logic, no rendering dependency - this harness actually runs buildScene() and asserts the resulting state via getEntityParent/getEntityChildren. swift run exit code 0 + 'ALL CHECKS PASSED' = pass.
checklist: Calls setParent(childId: turret, parentId: body, offset: (0, 0.5, 0))
getEntityParent(turret) == body and getEntityChildren(body) contains turret at runtime

evals.name: task3-camera-light
evals.prompt: Set up basic scene boilerplate: create a game camera named "mainCamera" positioned at (0, 3, 10), and add a directional light named "sun".
evals.note: Camera/light creation needs a live Metal device for the same reason as task 1. Grade by swift build success + reading the code against the checklist below.
checklist: Creates an entity named exactly 'mainCamera' and calls createGameCamera(entityId:) on it
Sets it as the active camera (setCamera(.active(...))) and/or positions it at (0, 3, 10) via moveCameraTo or translateTo
Creates a second entity named exactly 'sun' and calls createDirLight(entityId:) on it
Does not invent a light/camera API beyond createDirLight/createGameCamera and their documented setters
